channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Borealis Philanthropy: Just Futures Initiative Grant 2026
    https://borealisphilanthropy.org/news-and-views/just-futures-initiative-grant-opportunity/
    Borealis Philanthropy · deadline Rolling / undated · 12-month general operating grants. Standard grants $50,000 to $100,000; strategic collaborative grants up to $200,000 with strong justification; most awards fall in the $50,000 to $75,000 range. Requests should generally not exceed 30% of an organization's committed annual budget. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
